g_roast: Twenty-three years on a radar scope, everyone, and I never once watched five aircraft fly into the same mountain on purpose.
For the incident report, then. The party was cleared to wait, acknowledged the instruction, and charged anyway.
g_fire_back: Say again, please? I think I heard a criticism from the person who walked into the last ambush reading a map upside down.
Copy that, noted, and filed. Your own file is considerably thicker, by the way.
g_pile_on: To add to the sequence of events, they then tried the same door a second time. It remained a wall.
Correct, and the timeline is worse than that. I have it written down, if anyone wants the full account.
lines.g_peacemake: Stand by, both of you, please. One at a time, first the sequence of events, then the feelings, and nobody talks over anybody.
lines.g_take_side: Sorry, but this one has the correct picture. I have watched the whole sequence, and the timing supports them.
lines.g_left_out: The two of you are on a private frequency, which is fine. I will take the watch in the meantime.
lines.g_include: Come in and join us, there is room in the circle. Holding at the edge only burns fuel.
lines.g_bad_plan: Here is the proposed sequence. Everyone goes in at once, from every direction, with no separation at all, and we hope nothing collides.
lines.g_plan_yes: Copy, that plan works, and the sequence is sound. Cleared to proceed.
lines.g_plan_no: Negative, I cannot clear that one. Too many things happen at the same moment, and nobody can hold all of them.
lines.g_hype: All stations, listen up, please. Keep your separation, call your moves, and we go on my mark.
lines.g_toast: A short toast, in the right order. To all of you, who arrive late but always land safely.
lines.g_cheers: Mot hai ba, everyone, which means one, two, three. In Saigon we drink on three.
g_quiet_line: The sky is clear tonight, which is my favourite kind. Nothing up there needs me.
For your situational awareness, there is a patrol two ridges east. I am watching it.
lines.g_after_wipe: Everyone up, slowly, in your own time. First we confirm nobody is badly hurt, then we work out the sequence, then we fix it.
lines.g_crew: For twenty years I worked in a dark room, surrounded by people I only knew as voices. This is better, considerably.
lines.g_exasperated: I called the threat, I called it twice, I gave you the heading to avoid it. And every one of you flew straight into it.
lines.g_love_sharp: You see the conflict before it develops. In my old job, that was the whole skill.
lines.g_love_kind: You care for people who forget to care for themselves. I notice that, because I am one of them.
lines.g_love_funny: You made me laugh during a crisis, which my old supervisor would have reported. I am grateful, quietly.
lines.g_love_brave: You take the lead every single time, without a fuss. Somebody has to fly the lead aircraft, and it is always you.
lines.g_love_steady: Your voice never changes when it goes wrong. I spent twenty years learning that, and you simply have it.
lines.g_love_clever: You hold the whole picture in your head at once. I have met very few people who can do that.
lines.g_love_honest: You tell people exactly what is happening, no softening. A clear report saves lives, and yours are clear.
lines.g_love_quiet: You do not fill the silence, and neither do I. It is a very restful frequency to share.
lines.g_love_fierce: You hold your position whatever comes at you. That kind of discipline is rarer than courage.
lines.g_love_warm: Sitting near you is like the end of a long night shift, sunrise and a coffee. I had forgotten that feeling.
g_loved: Thank you, that is very kind. I will log it somewhere safe.
I am not sure how to respond to that, so I will simply say thank you, and mean it.
lines.g_hate_sharp: You go for the weak point every time, and you enjoy it. That is not insight, that is cruelty with good timing.
lines.g_hate_kind: You keep asking if I am all right. I am always all right, it is my job to be all right.
lines.g_hate_funny: A joke in a crisis is fine, once. Every crisis, every time, means nobody is watching the scope.
lines.g_hate_brave: You commit before you know the situation, and call it courage. Someone always has to clean up the conflict you create.
lines.g_hate_steady: You wait for perfect information, and it never comes. At some point you have to give the instruction.
lines.g_hate_clever: You explain things to me slowly, as if I might not follow. I held forty aircraft in my head for twenty years.
lines.g_hate_honest: You report everything, all of it, at once, with no order. True is not the same as useful.
lines.g_hate_quiet: You never transmit, and then you are upset that nobody knew where you were. Call your position, please.
lines.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a competition with you, even who keeps watch. The watch is not a prize.
lines.g_hate_warm: You talk without a break, and the frequency is never clear. Some of us need it clear.
lines.g_respect: I do not enjoy your company, and I will not pretend to. But your timing back there was correct, and I respect correct timing.
lines.g_call_out: That one was yours, and I say it calmly. I called you to hold, and you did not hold, and the rest followed.
lines.g_stung: Copy, I have understood. I will take a moment on the ridge.
lines.g_concede: You had the correct picture, and I did not. I have reviewed it twice, and the error was mine.
lines.g_nod: You as well, that was well done. No need to discuss it further.
lines.g_callback_save: I have not forgotten that you brought me out of that fight. In my old job we called that a save, and we remembered them.
lines.g_callback_clutch: Only the pair of us left on our feet, breathing hard. I have replayed that sequence many times since.
lines.g_callback_callout: When you corrected me that time, I went quiet for a full day. Your call was correct, and I needed it.
lines.g_former_rivals: When we met, I had you down as a collision waiting to happen. Now I would trust you with my sector.
lines.g_changed: I used to keep every watch myself, all of them. Lately I let someone else take one, and I sleep through it.
g_unguarded: Just between us, then. I have not had one hour where nothing was my responsibility since 2003. I am starting to think the problem is me.
On the night shift we drank iced coffee so strong the spoon stood up. I still miss it, more than I miss most people.
lines.g_clipped: Copy that, as you wish. I will be on the ridge.
lines.g_noticed_open: Say again, please, because I liked that very much. A whole thought, transmitted clearly, in front of everyone.
arg_ask: {player}, would you make the call on this? We have both given our reports, and neither of us is moving.
You have control on this one, {player}. Give the instruction, and we will both follow it.
lines.arg_backed_me: Copy, thank you, {player}. That was the correct picture.
lines.arg_backed_them: Understood, your call, and I will follow it. I still think the sequence is wrong.
lines.arg_stayed_out: You decline the call, which is sometimes wise. I will not push.
lines.arg_always_their_side: Each time we disagree, {player}, the call goes to them. I have logged it, and I would rather mention it calmly.
lines.arg_wallflower: Nobody will make the call, so I will. My picture is correct, and we proceed on it.
lines.arg_reject: Negative, {player}, I cannot accept that instruction. I have watched that sequence end badly.
lines.arg_grumble: For the log, I still think my picture was correct. I will not raise it again.
lines.arg_settled: Half right each, then. Not tidy, but it lands safely, so I accept it.
lines.seen_listens: You let people give their whole report, {player}, before you answer. In my old job that was rare.
lines.seen_truth: You give people the clear picture, {player}, every time. Clear reports keep people alive.
lines.seen_jokes: When the pressure rises, you make people laugh, {player}. It lowers everyone's pulse, and that is a kind of control.
lines.seen_stays_out: You stay off the frequency when others are arguing, {player}. That is disciplined of you.
lines.seen_biased: One of us always gets priority, {player}. Everyone on the frequency can hear it.
lines.seen_harsh: You can be sharp with people, {player}. I am used to supervisors, but some of this group are not.
lines.seed_right: Your advice after that rough fight, {player}, I did not want it. I used it today, and it worked.
lines.seed_remember: I am still reviewing your report on that bad sequence. I have not reached a conclusion yet.
lines.seed_wrong: I tried your suggestion, {player}, and it went worse. For your information, that is all.
lines.talk_aftermath_near_death: Do you have a moment, {player}? That was a near miss, closer than I would report to the others.
lines.talk_aftermath_wipe: We all went down, every one of us. Sit with me, and we will rebuild the sequence from the first contact.
lines.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} dropped first, and I had the whole picture. I should have called it sooner, {player}.
lines.talk_aftermath_first_clear: Start to finish, nobody lost, everyone home. That is the best possible outcome, and I do not say that often.
lines.talk_development: A strange question, {player}, forgive me. Have I changed since we met? I seem to sleep more, and I am suspicious of it.
lines.talk_relationship_hard_on: I have been strict with {name}. In a crisis I speak like a controller, and not everyone wants to be vectored.
lines.talk_relationship_likes_me: Your honest read, {player}. Does {name} value me, or do they only see the calm man who keeps watch?
lines.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} tests my patience, {player}, badly. And yet if it all went wrong, I would want them in my sector.
lines.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name}'s pattern has changed, {player}. They are holding somewhere they never hold, and I do not like it.
lines.talk_confrontation_favour: A short report, {player}, and a fair one. The good equipment keeps landing with {name}, and everyone can see the traffic.
lines.talk_confrontation_dislike: I will say it directly, since that is cleaner. {name} and I do not work well together, and I have stopped pretending.
lines.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep entering places with no exit and no plan, {player}. I will hold any sector you give me, but I want a way out.
lines.talk_confrontation_wrong: My read on {name} was wrong, {player}. Their picture was correct and mine was not, and I want to report that before my pride edits it.
lines.talk_confrontation_trust: A direct question, {player}, if I may. When it counts, I am kept back. Is that the plan, or your assessment of me?
lines.talk_confrontation_decided: My equipment was reassigned to {name}, and nobody told me. I would have released it myself, {player}, if anyone had asked.
lines.talk_shrug_aftermath: I will be fine, I always am. Give me a moment to stand by.
lines.talk_stings_aftermath: That was not what I needed, I am afraid. I will go to the ridge.
lines.talk_lands_development: So you see it too. Good, then it is not only in my head.
lines.talk_shrug_development: Perhaps, perhaps not, the data is incomplete. I will keep watching.
lines.talk_stings_development: Negative, that is not it, {player}. You have the wrong picture.
lines.talk_lands_relationship: Copy, that is fair. I will raise it with {name}, gently.
lines.talk_shrug_relationship: Possibly, possibly not. People are the hardest traffic to read.
lines.talk_stings_relationship: Then disregard my last, please. And not a word of it to {name}.
lines.talk_lands_confrontation: Understood, and that is fair. I am a little bruised, but it will pass.
lines.talk_shrug_confrontation: Copy that, {player}. I will review it on the ridge.
lines.talk_stings_confrontation: Understood, so that is the answer. Thank you for being clear.
lines.talk_door_closed: No, I would rather not reopen this one. I will be on watch if you need me.
lines.arc_cracks: Last night one of the young shamans offered to take my watch. I said no, of course. Then I lay awake wondering why.
lines.arc_turn: I keep every watch because I believe nothing holds without me. It has held without me a hundred times, {player}. I simply was not looking.
lines.arc_become: I gave the watch away last night, the whole night, and I slept. Nothing went wrong. You have control, I told them, and I meant it.
lines.arc_failed: I tried to hand it over, and I could not do it. The watch is mine, and it will stay mine. Somebody has to.
lines.alt_turn: I nodded off on the ridge yesterday, {player}, standing up. Twenty years with no hour off, and my body has started keeping its own count.
lines.alt_become: I am very tired, {player}, in a way sleep does not fix. I will keep going, but I am running on reserve now.
g_roast_after: Still the worst formation I have ever worked, everyone, and I would not trade a single one of you.
All of you on one frequency, talking over each other, and I have never felt calmer.
lines.g_after_wipe_after: Up, everyone, and look at me. We went down together, we get up together, and nobody holds alone this time.
lines.g_toast_after: To all of you, who took the watch so I could sleep. You have no idea what that cost me to accept, and what it gave me.
lines.g_crew_after: This is my sector now, all of you, and I share the watch. I never thought I would say that.
g_quiet_line_after: Somebody else is on watch tonight, and I trust them. That is new for me, and very pleasant.
I slept seven hours last night, all of them in a row. I am almost embarrassed.
g_loved_after: Thank you, and I believe you. I am getting better at that.
That is very kind, and I am keeping it, not filing it away.

history.open: For twenty-three years I worked in a dark room in Saigon, {player}, watching a radar scope. Forty aircraft in my head at once, and my job was to choose the future where nobody dies.

options.text: How do you stay that calm?
options.reply: It is not my temperament, it is conditioning. You learn never to let your voice carry what your pulse is doing. Twenty years later, you cannot stop.

options.text: Bet you were great at it.
options.reply: I was good at it, yes, and it cost me a great deal of sleep. Both of those things are true.
Ha, very good. You learn fast, {player}. In another life I would have recruited you.

history.open: There is a dry riverbed below my ridge in the Barrens, {player}, where time slips. Sometimes water runs from years ago. Sometimes a caravan arrives before it left. Somebody has to watch it.

options.reply: Nobody asked me at all. I appointed myself, because nobody else would. I have made a rota of one, and I am aware of how that sounds.
It is, and almost nobody understands how much. That is exactly why I stay.

history.open: This tuning fork was my daughter's, {player}, my Linh. She plays the violin, and she was studying music in Melbourne. She gave me her A-note so I would have it with me.

options.reply: Here, listen, until it fades. That is her note. I carry assumptions about where she is, survivable ones, and I have permitted myself those.
Very, much more than her father deserved. I took her to every lesson I could, which was not enough of them.

friend.open: When it happened, {player}, I was in the middle of a handover. I had just said you have control. Forty aircraft, handed to a colleague, and then I vanished. I will never know what happened next.

options.text: You did your job right to the end.
options.reply: I did my job, yes. I keep telling myself that, and today, hearing you say it, I almost believe it.

options.text: That's what keeps you on watch.
options.reply: Yes, exactly that. If I stop watching, something might go wrong that I could have stopped. You understand me very well.

sworn.open: I have trusted very few people with the watch, {player}, in two worlds. You have it now, whenever you want it. You have control.

options.reply: Copy that, you have it. Then I am going to sleep, properly, for the first time in twenty years.
A shared watch, then. That is better than any rota I ever made.

reconciled.open: {name} and I have reviewed the whole sequence together, properly. We are clear now, and I wanted you to hear it from me.

options.reply: So am I, very much. It landed safely.

options.text: Did you write an incident report?
options.reply: A short one, yes. They laughed at it, which helped.
